answer.main_body: hammock bed suspended between two posts
answer.evidence: The hammock is drawn almost entirely as a flat front elevation. The interior/top opening of the hammock is reduced to a 1-pixel dark band along row 3, and the support posts have no visible top caps.

The hammock and supporting posts are drawn in pure front elevation; the posts are flat vertical columns and the hammock sling is drawn facing directly toward the camera with only a 1-2px dark rim at rows 2-3 rather than a foreshortened hollow bed seen from above.

The hammock is drawn almost entirely in side/front elevation: the outer belly occupies 7 pixel rows (rows 4-10) while the interior opening/bed surface is only 2 pixel rows tall (rows 2-3). The side posts are also drawn as flat vertical elevation bars.
